Potential Improvements There are, however, a couple things I would change about this Galaxy. First, I’m not sure what the purpose of the “Edge” is on these phones (referring to the curved sides). I would prefer if there was still an option for a flat display. This is simply a personal preference, and many users like the Edge. My second concern, like many other reviewers, is the location of the finger print scanner which is very near the camera. The problem with this location is that users can accidentally touch the camera lens and smudge it. The third, and last concern I have, is Bixby. Samsung devoted a button to this function, just below the volume rocker.
